name: key-slime-pudding-banish-ability-never-fires
notes:
Key Slime Pudding (4wuq20gvcg, REGALIA,ITEM): "Banish CARDNAME: Until end of turn, Slime allies that enter the field under your control enter with an additional buff counter on them." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): this fixture documents the Banish ability CURRENTLY silently never firing when clicked on the field -- the same categorization-defect CLASS already documented for Baby Blue Slime elsewhere in this suite (see the NOTE near the top of this batch file, just above the Silvie Re:Collection fixtures), now independently confirmed on a second card.

Key Slime Pudding's ability is registered in $cardActivatedAbilities['4wuq20gvcg:0'] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) -- the reserve-cost activate-from-hand/material dictionary backed by CardCardActivatedCount() -- rather than $activateAbilityAbilities (the free/repeatable field-ability dictionary backed by CardActivateAbilityCount()) that Bauble of Mending's structurally-IDENTICAL 'Banish self: <effect>' ability correctly uses (see bauble-of-mending-banish-draw-class-bonus-life). Confirmed live with a standalone debug harness, two independent ways: (1) GetPlayableOpportunityChoices() -- the function that builds the fast-opportunity choice list a 'myField-N@Activate-0@Banish' click needs to match against to route through the WORKING ExecuteStaticMethods path -- never includes Key Slime Pudding's ability at all, confirmed both before and after opening a fast-opportunity window via Pass (it only surfaces $activateAbilityAbilities-registered abilities). (2) A direct 'myField-N@Activate-0@Banish' click with the decision queue empty returns success=YES (no error) but is a complete no-op: Key Slime Pudding stays on the field (not banished to myBanish), and no '4wuq20gvcg' global effect is ever set. This matches CustomInput.php's own documented routing (its 'myField' case sends a CardActivateAbilityCount()===0 && CardCardActivatedCount()>0 target through ActivateCard() instead of ActivateAbility()) and the same DoActivateCard()-based pipeline already shown broken for Baby Blue Slime's REST ability. Confidence: HIGH / directly confirmed live (not just a theory by analogy to Baby Blue Slime) -- both the opportunity-list omission and the no-op field click were independently reproduced for THIS card.

Key Slime Pudding is seeded directly onto the field (REGALIA/ITEM cards are redirected out of hand into the material deck by HandAddReplacement(), so seeding it onto myField directly -- same technique as bauble-of-mending-banish-draw-class-bonus-life -- is the correct way to reach a field-resident REGALIA precondition here, rather than a genuine materialize). This fixture pins the CURRENT (buggy, inert) observed behavior as a regression baseline so a future fix to the generator's $cardActivatedAbilities/$activateAbilityAbilities categorization (likely the SAME underlying fix needed for Baby Blue Slime) is easy to spot (the assertions below will need updating once that's fixed).

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Until end of turn, Slime allies that enter the field under your control enter with an additional buff counter on them.

engineBug.summary: Confirmed live, a second independent instance of the Baby Blue Slime categorization bug class: Key Slime Pudding's Banish ability is registered in $cardActivatedAbilities (the reserve-cost hand/material dictionary) instead of $activateAbilityAbilities (the free field-ability dictionary Bauble of Mending's identical-shape ability correctly uses). GetPlayableOpportunityChoices() never offers it as a fast-opportunity choice, and a direct field click silently no-ops (success=YES, but nothing moves and no global effect is set) instead of routing through a working activation path.
engineBug.affectedFunction: GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php's $cardActivatedAbilities['4wuq20gvcg:0'] registration (should be $activateAbilityAbilities, mirroring hLHpI5rHIK:0's correct categorization); dispatched (or rather, not dispatched) via Custom/CustomInput.php's 'myField' case and Custom/OpportunityLogic.php's GetPlayableOpportunityChoices()/GetPlayableFastAbilities().
